newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB shares dive further as stock re-rated.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB shares dive further as stock re-rated.

text.p: Mounting concerns about the loss of two top executives and an equity stake in terrestrial digital TV have wiped 1.7 billion stg off the value of British Sky Broadcasting.
Some analysts said on Monday that the shares, which fell 17p to 480.5 in late morning trade, could fall as low as 350p. One broker said "wildly optimistic" cases could value the shares at 450p.
Others said the falls were overdone.

What one analyst described as "very negative" weekend newspaper reports helped compound last week's share falls sparked by a report in the Financial Times that BSkyB could be shut out of the bidding for new digital TV licences, expects said.

The newspaper reported last week that the television watchdog, the Independent Television Commission, had told BSkyB that it should drop its one-third stake in a consortium with commercial TV groups Carlton Communications Plc and Granada Group Plc.
